import sys

MOD = 51123987

def count_crossing_palindromes(n, s):
    def expand_around_center(left, right):
        count = 0
        while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]:
            for i in range(left + 1, right):
                count += prefix_sum[right + 1] - prefix_sum[i]
            for i in range(left, right):
                suffix_count[i] += prefix_sum[right + 1] - prefix_sum[i + 1]
            left -= 1
            right += 1
        return count

    prefix_sum = [0] * (n + 1)
    suffix_count = [0] * n
    total_crossings = 0

    for i in range(n):
        total_crossings += expand_around_center(i, i)
        total_crossings += expand_around_center(i, i + 1)

    for i in range(n):
        total_crossings += suffix_count[i]

    return total_crossings % MOD

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
s = input[1]
print(count_crossing_palindromes(n, s))
